name: Second Battle of Mag Tuired
text: Second Battle of Mag Tuired, printed also as Moytura and Moytirra, gives the English title. The tale itself is headed Cath Maige Tuired. The dictionary routes this headword to that article. The Mag Tuired nodes carry the fuller record. The encyclopedia keeps the printed English title on its own row.
